content: <thought>We have the test set evaluation metrics from evaluate_xgboost_model. Next, we need to perform 5‑fold cross‑validation on the training data to obtain the mean and standard deviation of R². We'll use perform_cross_validation with the training CSV path, target column, and cv_folds=5. After obtaining those results, we will combine the test_set_evaluation (including mae, rmse, r2, and feature_importance) and cross_validation_results (r2_mean, r2_std) into a JSON object and write it to /Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_evaluate_model_performance_trial_10/model_evaluation_results.json. Finally, we will output the path to this results file.
